As of that date, HLP003 has been shown to be safe and tolerable at all doses evaluated with no serious adverse events or discontinuations due to adverse events having been observed in the final dose cohort. 12 On October 31, 2023, the Company announced Phase 2a interim results for HLP003, demonstrating a rapid, robust and statistically significant reduction in symptoms of depression three weeks following a single 12 mg dose compared to placebo, in participants with moderate to severe MDD.

On November 30, 2023, the Company announced positive Phase 2a topline results for HLP003, showing rapid and robust improvements in symptoms of depression after single doses of HLP003, with an average 14.1 point difference in MADRS score reduction between HLP003 and placebo which was statistically significant at 3 weeks (p<0.0001).
